name: BitMart Card
summary: A Visa-powered crypto card drawing directly from your BitMart Spot Account with real-time conversion and tiered cashback rewards.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the BitMart Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$120.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the BitMart Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the BitMart Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
